# WordDB

> > WordDB is a comprehensive English language reference platform offering word-finding tools, rhyming dictionaries, and vocabulary resources for word games, creative writing, and language learning.

WordDB provides specialized tools for Wordle, Scrabble, Words With Friends, and other word games, alongside resources for poets and songwriters including an advanced rhyming dictionary that serves as an alternative to RhymeZone. The platform offers extensive word lists, antonym references, and phonetic matching capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Wordle solver and word-finding tools
- Rhyming dictionary for poetry and lyrics
- Scrabble and Words With Friends resources
- Antonyms and opposite words
- Word lists by letter patterns
- Phonetic matching and sound-alike words
- Vocabulary building and reference
- English dictionary and thesaurus
- Creative writing tools
- Word game assistance
- Letter-based word search
- Lyric writing resources
- WordFeud support

## Core Word Tools

- [Wordle Solver Tool | Get Todays Wordle Word!](https://www.worddb.com/wordle_solver): Wordle solver tool to find today's word using placed/valid/invalid letters
- [WordDB's Advanced Rhyming Dictionary](https://www.worddb.com/rhyming_dictionary): Advanced rhyming dictionary for poets, songwriters - alternative to RhymeZone

## Word Reference & Vocabulary

- [List of 8 Opposite Words for Busy](https://www.worddb.com/opposite-word-for/busy): Antonyms and opposite words for 'busy' including idle, calm, free, lazy
- [List of Words That Start With "Y"](https://www.worddb.com/words/starting-with/y): Word list starting with Y for Wordle, Scrabble, Words With Friends
